initialization.method: fresh seed reset immediately before every N1 construction after backbone load; identical N1 config for both loss arms so the same seed must give byte-identical initial heads; no warmstart, no checkpoint, no R15 weights

formula.text: N=sum_c n_c=640 on train action_valid rows only; K_present=|{c:n_c>0}|; u_c=min(5,sqrt(N/(K_present*n_c))); Z=sum_{c:n_c>0} n_c*u_c/N; w_c=u_c/Z. Absent classes have no target and no weight. For each full80 batch, L_action=sum_{i valid} w_yi*(-log softmax(logits_i)[y_i])/sum_{i valid} w_yi; control uses original unweighted action loss; L_total=L_original-L_original_action+L_action, aux coefficients/losses unchanged.

spec.formula: N=sum_c n_c=640 on train action_valid rows only; K_present=|{c:n_c>0}|; u_c=min(5,sqrt(N/(K_present*n_c))); Z=sum_{c:n_c>0} n_c*u_c/N; w_c=u_c/Z. Absent classes have no target and no weight. For each full80 batch, L_action=sum_{i valid} w_yi*(-log softmax(logits_i)[y_i])/sum_{i valid} w_yi; control uses original unweighted action loss; L_total=L_original-L_original_action+L_action, aux coefficients/losses unchanged.

train.data: original R10 train 8 events only; validation 8 never trained and never used for weights/epochs/selection
train.order: original train order roundrobin step modulo8; 25 visits each

features: one genuine CUDA batch16 encode pass over the original 16x80 rows, shared RAM tensors between all arms, no disk feature cache
precision: FP32 no AMP, matmul TF32 false, cuDNN TF32 false, float32 precision highest in encode/train/evaluate/closed-loop

confirmation_worlds.construction: tactical_teacher_validation.ValidationWorld via make_world; same advance/firing/canonical geometry as R8/R9; split field is confirmation
confirmation_worlds.usage: closed-loop confirmation only; never trained, never used for weight/epoch/model selection, no teacher label created

closed_loop.runner: unchanged R11 run_event / pixel_stack / render_state / executed_history; sticky collision continue full horizon; per-event hidden reset
closed_loop.b0: same renderer and runner with the frozen baseline policy logits only; a reference on these renders, not a real B0 capability measurement
closed_loop.order: six checkpoints trained, saved with SHA, reloaded and SHA-checked first; confirmation 24 events then old8 validation continuity control
closed_loop.metrics: per event feasible/survived/goal/firsthit; per family event counts; decisions, raw-unsupported and invalid counts

failure_policy: retain first failure; one fixed run, no extra epochs, no baseline switch, no weight change, no overwrite
